description: arXiv:2610.02975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving search is a promising approach to scientific discovery. However, high-fidelity evaluation of every candidate is prohibitively expensive in some domains. Self-evolving systems in such settings therefore rely on low-cost but imperfect proxy rewards, which may assign high scores to infeasible candidates....
author: Kangjun Noh, Soyu Kim, Kyungwoo Song
